# third_party

Vendored libraries. Each directory keeps the library's licence and the pinned version below; a dependency builds with clang
and `zig c++` and needs no install step (ARCHITECTURE.md, rules).

Patched, `node-api/patches/0001-quickjs-ng-0.17-and-fast-calls.patch`: the external ArrayBuffer through quickjs-ng 0.17's realloc callback, the handles by value in blocks instead of one allocation each, a handle scope around every callback (upstream frees a callback's values only when a scope is closed by hand, so a hot function grew the heap), a short path for plain calls with the arguments read in place, numbers read from their tag (napi_number_expected for anything else, as in Node); `0002-javascriptcore-fast-calls.patch`: a function's record as its own private data (one callable class with Function.prototype, instead of a sentinel found behind a symbol at every call: 309 to 128 ns), the immediates made once, a callback that returns nothing gives undefined; `0003-v8-15.patch`: V8 15's API (the type tags of internal fields and externals, the V2 string writes, the isolate from the entered context, a per-isolate key for the type tags) and no `V8_ENABLE_SANDBOX` forced in the headers (the build of V8 decides: with Homebrew's, the root offsets were wrong and every boolean broke). Ours, not upstream: `node-api/quickjs/napi/inline.h`, the hot calls inlined into code compiled for QuickJS) | MIT | The one binding ABI of the JavaScript engines (docs/reports/js-engines-jsc-v8.md, ZN-773): the engine's bindings and the plugins call Node-API, QuickJS-ng, JavaScriptCore and V8 implement it |
